messages:
Alex: FYI I opened a PR that merges the private/VPC installer snippets into a single 'sealed-site' section. Trying to reduce duplication across KMS/HSM and proxy docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288
Morgan: nice. can you paste the new HSM snippet here? quick eyeball.
Alex: sure — main change is consoliding PKCS11 examples and adding an offline note:
```bash
# example PKCS11 env for HSM plugin
export PKCS11_MODULE=/usr/lib/libykcs11.so
export PKCS11_TOKEN_LABEL=redwood-hsm
```
Zara: looks fine but note our SUSE package path is /usr/lib64 for the appliance build — that broke a customer test last month. we should show both paths or conditional.
SRE-Jen: also add a short note re: MTU for tunnel interfaces. I've seen fragmentation on sealed links; add the `sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward` check and `mtu` hints.
Alex: good call. adding a small box: "If you route over IPSec tunnels, set MTU lower (e.g. 1400) & enable MSS clamping."
Samir: on the SDK side, could we include a tiny Node snippet showing the installer preflight check against KMS endpoint via proxy chaining? customers keep asking for it.
Alex: yep planning to add both Node+Python examples. draft Node snippet: ```js
// proxy-aware kms preflight
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
await fetch('https://kms.internal.local/health', {
  agent: new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTP_PROXY)
});
```
Morgan: and a short shell one-liner would be helpful for ops: `curl -x http://proxy:3128 --insecure https://kms.internal.local/health`
Zara: PR note: the example for PKCS11 in the current file references `slot=0` by default. for YubiHSM v2 we recommend `slot=1`. please add a note and test vector.
Alex: will do. also adding a tiny nftables example for sealed sites (most docs have iptables, better to show nftables as well):
```bash
# allow egress to KMS on 443
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 10.0.0.5 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
# nftables equivalent
nft add rule ip filter output ip daddr 10.0.0.5 tcp dport 443 accept
```
SRE-Jen: +1, but please include how to persist the nft rules on Debian/Ubuntu systems (systemd service or `nft list ruleset > /etc/nftables.conf`).
docs-bot: CI check passed for docs build (linkcheck disabled for internal URLs) :white_check_mark:
Samir: one more ask: for the air-gapped section, include a short checksum verification snippet for the offline bundle and mention `gpg --verify` steps. customers trip on this during cutover.
Alex: ok adding a 3-step offline bundle checklist: 1) checksum verify, 2) import packages, 3) kube manifest dry-run.
Morgan: also please fix the dead link in the migration guide: the 'legacy-keys' anchor 404s — PR should update to `#legacy-key-migration`.
Alex: thanks — i'll push an amend. assigning: Zara to confirm HSM lib paths & slot note; Samir to drop Node+Python SDK snippets into PR; Morgan to add anchor/link fix; SRE-Jen to add MTU/sniffing tips. i'll update PR tonight and ping for a final review.
Zara: I'll test locally tomorrow and comment on PR.
Samir: adding SDK snippets now, ping when done.
Morgan: i'll open a tiny follow-up PR if linkfix causes any conflict.
Alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup: — leaving the PR open for reviews, will mark as WIP until checks pass. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288#issuecomment-1
